visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a tight black long-sleeved athletic top and black joggers walks toward a gym entrance gate. The screen features a video game interface with a clock, money counter, and mini-map in the corners. He performs a high-knee kick motion near the gate. (2) He approaches an exercise bike and mounts it briefly before standing back up. The camera follows him from behind as he walks deeper into the brightly lit gym filled with strength training machines. (3) He stops in front of a seated muscular man wearing a black t-shirt, a cap, and a cross necklace. They engage in a conversation with large yellow subtitles appearing on screen. The first man sits on a chest press machine and begins repetitions. (4) As he exercises, a '+1 肌肉' (Muscle +1) notification and a '波波好感度提升' (Bobo's Favorability Increased) bar appear. The trainer hands him a small white packet. The first man consumes the powder directly from the packet, reacting with an exaggerated expression. (5) The screen shifts to a rapid montage of high-contrast promotional slides for MyProtein products, including protein powder, bars, and crisps, with pricing and discount codes prominently displayed.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main protagonist in black athletic wear, 1 secondary male trainer (Bobo), and 1 female background gym-goer seen briefly.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main character wears a black tight-fitting compression shirt, black track pants, and white sneakers. The second main character (trainer) wears a black t-shirt with 'Verve' branding, a black baseball cap, and a silver cross necklace.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern commercial gym featuring various strength equipment (chest press, cable machines), cardio equipment (air bikes), and a wall displaying merchandise/apparel. The flooring is grey tile and rubber matting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a low-tempo hip-hop beat featuring a steady drum machine rhythm and a repetitive synth melody. A sharp digital 'blip' UI sound accompanies the visual gate interaction. (2) Two male voices engage in a conversation. One has a deeper, calm tone (Bobo), while the other is slightly higher in pitch. They speak Mandarin with clear articulation. The background music remains consistent in volume. (3) During the chest press exercise, a melodic 'level-up' chime sounds, followed by percussive 'thud' sound effects for each repetition. (4) A loud, distorted 'Oh My God!' vocal sample triggers a transition into a high-energy promotional segment. The narrator's voice becomes faster and more enthusiastic, listing product names and discount codes over a more aggressive electronic beat with heavy bass.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a MyProtein flash sale by leveraging a popular 'Grand Theft Auto' (GTA) video game parody format. The video uses gaming nostalgia and humorous gym tropes to engage the audience before delivering a direct call-to-action regarding discount codes and sale dates.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of products, mention of specific discount codes, and full-screen promotional graphics detailing sale prices and dates.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes a GTA San Andreas aesthetic (UI, font, BGM) to create a comedic narrative that transitions seamlessly into a product promotion.
